user.title: Initial setup
user.description: Choose the weather source, set indoor comfort values, and optionally pick notification devices.

data.safety_bypass_quiet_hours: Allow safety notifications during quiet hours
data.debug_mode_enabled: Shows per-room open and close notification test controls. Debug notifications are informational only and never execute Home Assistant automations.

data_description.outdoor_weather_entity_id: Choose the standard Home Assistant weather entity VentWise can use today. If you do not see the source you need, open a GitHub issue.
data_description.target_temperature_c: Enter the indoor temperature in {temperature_unit} that feels comfortable when you are home.
data_description.auto_comfort_temperature: Uses your comfort temperature as a baseline and adjusts it gradually from the perceived outdoor temperature. The adjustment is limited to ±2°C within an 18–26°C indoor safety range. Room sensors determine the recommendation but never move the target. This does not control a thermostat or HVAC system.
data_description.target_humidity_percent: Set the indoor humidity that feels comfortable when you are home.
data_description.stability_minutes: How long the recommendation should remain unchanged before notification. If you are not sure, leave the default value.
data_description.notification_device_id: Optional. Pick one or more devices that should receive VentWise notifications.
data_description.home_assistant_notification_enabled: Show each VentWise recommendation in Home Assistant's notification panel.
data_description.safety_bypass_quiet_hours: When enabled, urgent safety notifications may be delivered during quiet hours. Stability, cooldown, and duplicate suppression still apply.
data_description.diagnostic_notification_level: Choose whether Home Assistant shows extra notifications for configuration or sensor-data problems.
data_description.debug_mode_enabled: Shows per-room open and close notification test controls. Debug notifications are informational only and never execute Home Assistant automations.
data_description.co2_threshold_ppm: CO₂ level at which VentWise starts prioritizing fresh air.

outdoor.title: Outdoor data
outdoor.description: Use the checkboxes to decide which outdoor measurements come from Home Assistant entities instead of the weather forecast.

data_description.outdoor_temperature_override: Turn this on to enter a numeric temperature entity instead of using the weather forecast.
data_description.outdoor_humidity_override: Turn this on to enter a numeric humidity entity instead of using the weather forecast.
data_description.wind_speed_override: Turn this on to enter a numeric wind speed entity instead of using the weather forecast.

outdoor_overrides.title: Manual outdoor values
outdoor_overrides.description: Fill in only the fields you turned on with the checkboxes. Detected source units: {sensor_units_summary}.

data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity_id: Required only when manual temperature is enabled.
data_description.outdoor_temperature_unit: Optional. Use this when the selected sensor does not declare its unit correctly.
data_description.outdoor_humidity_entity_id: Required only when manual humidity is enabled.
data_description.outdoor_humidity_unit: Optional. Use this when the selected sensor does not declare its unit correctly.
data_description.wind_speed_entity_id: Required only when manual wind speed is enabled.
data_description.outdoor_wind_speed_unit: Optional. Use this when the selected sensor does not declare its unit correctly.

room_units.title: Sensor units
room_units.description: Review the units detected for the selected sensors. Detected source units: {sensor_units_summary}. Confirm or correct them before continuing. A ratio is a fraction from 0 to 1.

data_description.temperature_unit_override: Select the unit reported by the selected temperature sensor.
data_description.humidity_unit_override: Select the unit reported by the selected humidity sensor.
data_description.co2_unit_override: Select the unit reported by the selected CO₂ sensor.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Add, edit, or remove rooms and macro-rooms for spaces whose windows affect the same air.

menu_option_descriptions.add_room: Create one room for a single space or area.

settings.title: VentWise settings
settings.description: Set everyday comfort, notifications, and outdoor data here. Manual outdoor entities are required only when their matching switch is enabled.

data.debug_mode_enabled: Shows per-room open and close notification test controls. Debug notifications are informational only and never execute Home Assistant automations.
data.safety_bypass_quiet_hours: Allow safety notifications during quiet hours

data_description.outdoor_weather_entity_id: Choose the standard Home Assistant weather entity used by VentWise.
data_description.target_temperature_c: Set the indoor temperature that feels comfortable when you are home.
data_description.auto_comfort_temperature: Uses your comfort temperature as a baseline and adjusts it gradually from the perceived outdoor temperature. The adjustment is limited to ±2°C within an 18–26°C indoor safety range. Room sensors determine the recommendation but never move the target. This does not control a thermostat or HVAC system.
data_description.target_humidity_percent: Set the indoor humidity that feels comfortable when you are home.
data_description.stability_minutes: How long a recommendation must remain unchanged before VentWise notifies you.
data_description.notification_device_id: Optional. Pick devices that should receive VentWise notifications.
data_description.home_assistant_notification_enabled: Show each VentWise recommendation in Home Assistant's notification panel.
data_description.diagnostic_notification_level: Choose whether Home Assistant shows extra notifications for configuration or sensor-data problems.
data_description.debug_mode_enabled: Shows per-room open and close notification test controls. Debug notifications are informational only and never execute Home Assistant automations.
data_description.co2_enabled: Recommended when a CO₂ sensor is available. It prioritizes fresh air when CO₂ is high.
data_description.co2_entity_id: Optional default CO₂ sensor used by rooms without their own sensor.
data_description.co2_threshold_ppm: CO₂ level at which VentWise starts prioritizing fresh air.
data_description.soft_outdoor_threshold_c: Above this temperature outside, opening windows becomes less useful.
data_description.cooldown_minutes: How long VentWise waits before sending an updated recommendation for each room. Identical recommendations stay suppressed.
data_description.safety_bypass_quiet_hours: When enabled, urgent safety notifications may be delivered during quiet hours. Stability, cooldown, and duplicate suppression still apply.
